title: athyrium filix-femina var. pectinatum
intro: Athyrium filix-femina var. pectinatum, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a variety of the Lady Fern plant, a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Athyriaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support respiratory health and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lady Fern are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress, which may be beneficial for conditions such as anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Lady Fern include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
